arms: CONTROL (ordinary scaffold, invisible NFE telemetry only, no model-visible feedback)
TREATMENT (byte-identical + exactly ONE model-visible report at first save with nonempty live recalculated NFE delta; no further write episodes; no submit episode)
censoring_classes: VALID_SUBMISSION: submit tool invoked (workbook presence verified separately)
MODEL_NONCOMPLETION: TRUNCATED_CALL_LIMIT / TRUNCATED_INSTANCE_COST / NO_SUBMIT / call-timeout-exhausted (frozen budgets reached without submission is an outcome)
PROVIDER_CENSORED: PROVIDER_ERROR / API timeouts / refusals / infrastructure errors from provider
RUNNER_CENSORED: experiment-global spend cap binding (not expected at 25.00) or runner faults
WORKBOOK_INFRA_CENSORED: LO refresh / official-eval infrastructure failures

cost_policy.catalog: OpenRouter models catalog fetched at task start; frozen per-slot in run_record.catalog_prices
cost_policy.estimated_cost: sum(prompt_tokens*price_p + completion_tokens*price_c) per call; used ONLY for the instance stopping check
cost_policy.note: estimated-cost-cap termination is MODEL_NONCOMPLETION (a frozen budget outcome), never treatment efficiency; efficiency compared only on valid pairs
cost_policy.provider_reported_cost: usage dict recorded verbatim per call (incl. usage.cost when present); never used for stopping
cost_policy.stopping: before each model call: global spend>=25.00 -> CENSORED_CAP; instance estimated>=0.25 -> TRUNCATED_INSTANCE_COST. Identical both arms.

diagnostic.content: PART 6 exact template (see exact_report_template.json); factual state only; no gold/formulas/instructions/semantics/priority
diagnostic.delivery: appended to the successful save observation after truncation; zero model calls; informational; never blocks; fails open
diagnostic.episodes: at most ONE model-visible episode per trajectory; no submit-stage gate
diagnostic.failure: diagnostic exceptions recorded in live_nfe_events.jsonl and swallowed; write result unchanged
diagnostic.path: input via UNO as-is; current output recalculated (calculateAll + save recalculated copy + read); frozen new_formula_errors; _summarise-shaped selection (<=8/sheet, <=80)

endpoints.guard: paired official regression delta: mean>=-0.01 AND no task<=-0.02 (PROMISING); HARMFUL iff mean<=-0.02 OR any task<=-0.05
endpoints.mechanism: contact rate, report counts, shown resolution fraction, absolute NFE reduction, response/repair-write rates, post-report new errors, post-report calls, submission rate
endpoints.primary: paired official modification-accuracy delta (per-task, mean, median, wins/ties/losses, bootstrap 95% CI)

frozen_parameters.instance_prompts: benchmark/sweagent/spreadsheet-control.yaml instance_template (shared file; rendered paths differ by workdir only)
frozen_parameters.provider_routing: none (same as ordinary-agent census runner: no provider/reasoning params); actually-served provider recorded per call

gates: PARTs 16-17 verbatim (PROMISING 6 conditions incl. >=6/7 enriched contact, mean mod>=+0.05, reg safety, LOTO>0 every omission, >=50% contacted reduce NFE; NO_CAPABILITY_EFFECT; HARMFUL; INCONCLUSIVE)
population: see population.json (7 enriched + 1 clean control 01_06; MECHANISM_ENRICHED)
replication: no automatic reruns; at most one replacement per arm/task for provider/runner/workbook-infra failure only; scored-workbook reconstruction reruns allowed without new inference; primary and replacement separately labeled; never replicate surprising scores
reserve: see confirmation_reservation_hash.json (untouched unless full PROMISING passes)
scorer: official evaluation.py per category after open_spreadsheet.py LO refresh, same as representative_score.py; unmodified
